in_marathi.name: Divaakar
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God's divine chariot
in_marathi.long_meaning: Divaakar हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Divaakar is derived from the Sanskrit words 'diva' meaning 'god' and 'akar' meaning 'doer' or 'maker'. This name signifies the one who embodies the divine power and is responsible for making things happen. It is a revered name in Hindu mythology, associated with deities and spiritual leaders.
